mode.description: Mode: 'run' enriches all PCAP IPs, 'run_single' enriches one IP, 'show' displays cached enrichment, 'clear' removes cached enrichment.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of columns to SELECT from the table.

ip.description: Single IP to enrich (for run_single mode).

ip_column.description: Name of the IP address column in the BQ table (e.g. ip_addr, ip_address, src_ip).
